import re
from pathlib import Path
import tarfile
import tempfile
import os

# Constants
PATTERN = r"(?<!Distillr)\\\\AcroTray\.exe"
DIRECTORY = r"C:\\SomeDir\\"

def task_func(directory=DIRECTORY, file_pattern=PATTERN):
    fd, tar_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".tar")
    os.close(fd)
    
    pattern = re.compile(file_pattern)
    
    with tarfile.open(tar_path, "w") as tar:
        dir_path = Path(directory)
        if dir_path.exists() and dir_path.is_dir():
            for file_path in dir_path.rglob("*"):
                if file_path.is_file():
                    p1 = str(file_path)
                    p2 = str(file_path.absolute())
                    # Ensure compatibility with varying slash representations on different OS/environments
                    p3 = p1.replace("/", "\\")
                    p4 = p2.replace("/", "\\")
                    p5 = p3.replace("\\", "\\\\")
                    p6 = p4.replace("\\", "\\\\")
                    
                    if any(pattern.search(p) for p in [p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6]):
                        try:
                            arcname = str(file_path.relative_to(dir_path))
                        except ValueError:
                            arcname = file_path.name
                        tar.add(str(file_path), arcname=arcname)
                        
    return tar_path
